Title: IS there a 4 card limit on Jyhad ?

Messages.Author: Joeseph Angelo
Messages.Body:
Okay I am a magic player and wondered if there is a limit to the number
of each type of card one can have in a deck is a 4 of each limit like in
magic ?

Joe

Messages.Author: James R. McClure Jr.
Messages.Body:


Peace Joe,

No, there is not. Jyhad plays just fine w/o artificial card limits, though
pushed votes and multiply redundant actions can easily be degenerate.
By pushed votes, I mean, the ability to play Political Actions cards, beyond
the one required to call the vote, from your hand during a vote.
By multiply redundant actions, I mean, having a minion take an action, say
bleed, untap (through whatever means), take the identical action, untap,
take the identical action, ad nauseum.

Nil carborundum illigitimi,

James R. McClure Jr.
The OS/2 Apostle

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
ita...@netcom.com (Joeseph Angelo) writes:
>Okay I am a magic player and wondered if there is a limit to the number
>of each type of card one can have in a deck is a 4 of each limit like in
>magic ?

Certainly not. Also, the 4cl in magic only exists in Convocation
(tournament) rules (and most house rules).

Many house rules for VtES include a card limit (4,8,1,10%,50%, what-have-U),
usually 4cl, because of the influence of MtG. Official rules, as
well as tournament rules do not set a limit on the number of each card you
can have in your deck (generally - some card are banned, some are restricted).
)
